a.lede: Markets have been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US midterms.
a.title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown

b.lede: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.
b.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
